Haba shu lamkhmat ia ka lynter bad pyngkiang jong ka kot, ki Lynnong Banyngkong bad Baar ka long ka jingpyrshang ban ai jingbatai sa ia kawei pat ka tnat jong ka poetri, ka lyric. Kumba la sbem, ym pat sbym la don kano kano ka jingpyrshang batbikna _ ne ba- kyrparg ban batai ne pynsbai ia ki tnat babun jait jong ka poetri. Kum u nongbikai ia ka Kbasi, la sbem ba kum kine ki jait jingthob ki long kum ki kynja tbymmei ii jong kano kano ka jingsngcwthub bad jinghikal !a ka litereshor. Hangne ngim mut tang ba ka jiogiadei bad ka poetri, hyruei kumjub ruh had ka drama, nobel bad kiwei kiwei de. Ka long ka jingshisha ba lada ogim tip ei ei shaphang kane, ka jingpulc ne ka jinghikai ka long kaba shu tare haba dum ne tang na sla khlem nongrim. Don ban tylii ki kot kiba la tboh shaphang ka lyric bad del halor kine ba la lum la lang bad la thir la thaifi ia ki nia baroh. La kyrmen ba ki nongpule kin i’awad idih shuh shuh dalade halor kane ka phang, bad iehse ruh, baniipyndap ii kano kano kaba duna bad ban iakliel noh i'i kano kano kaba tam. Ki Lynnong Dalai, Basaw bad Basan, ka long ka jlngblshar la ka Khasi lyric naduh basdang haduh u snem 1975.
